given: no stock record exists for a given SKU at a given location
when: the operator files a stock level for that SKU at that location, providing the quantity and the inventory_code
then: a stock record is created for that (sku, location) pair capturing the quantity and the combined inventory_code
architectural_notes: Client-to-server round-trip: the operator submits the file-stock form and the browser must render the created-record confirmation from the live API response, so this is a client/server contract verified end-to-end (React SPA boundary at app/routes to service at app/services to repository at app/repositories writing the stock_records row). Cross-cutting: input validation owned at the app/routes boundary; the write transaction owned in the service layer. Owner module: app/services stock service coordinating app/repositories persistence.
